g.text: How much resembles a common response-amplitude change?
Primary log₂(CPM + 1); tested membership union excluded from the background fit.
Both axes reuse the same PBS libraries and contain measurement noise. β is an unclamped descriptive reference.
Gene rows and overlapping memberships are not independent biological replicates. Residuals do not identify STAT causality.
n counts eligible, uniquely mapped member rows; no confidence intervals or equivalence claim.
